svg.title: Three ways to establish a key; a probe per kind
svg.text: Three ways to agree a key. A probe that offers one says nothing about the other two.
a key share in a group
invisible to a probe that offers groups: a TLS 1.2 listener
can say no to every group and still agree a key both ways
PostgreSQL 18 with ssl_groups = 'X25519MLKEM768:X25519' and no ssl_dh_params_file refused secp256r1 and still completed
a handshake on a 2048-bit finite-field group it supplied itself (RFC 3526 group 14) and another on RSA key transport
or one full cipher-suite enumeration (testssl.sh -E), which reports the DHE suites and the size of the group behind them
